evidence: Extensively modifies wallet transaction generation (src/wallet/spend.cpp), coin selection, fee bumping (src/wallet/feebumper.cpp), and wallet storage (src/wallet/walletdb.cpp).
rationale: Adds wallet support for sending to BIP 352 Silent Payment addresses, a major user-facing privacy enhancement. It adapts coin selection, transaction output derivation, and database persistence to enable non-interactive address reuse prevention across standard sending RPCs.
